title: 11- Data Integration
text:
Copy the code below into the code cell and run it to load the data. Then extend it to complete the exercise.

--- STARTER CODE ---
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

url1 = 'https://github.com/muratfirat78/CPP_Datasets/raw/main/transactions2.csv'
url2 = 'https://github.com/muratfirat78/CPP_Datasets/raw/main/products_priced.csv'
url3 = 'https://github.com/muratfirat78/CPP_Datasets/raw/main/promotions2.csv'

transactions = pd.read_csv(url1)
products = pd.read_csv(url2)
promotions = pd.read_csv(url3)
transactions = transactions.dropna()
--- END STARTER CODE ---

Merge the three datasets into one dataframe called 'shoppingdata'. Use the right type of merge (left/right/inner/outer). Then handle missing values and define a 'price' column based on std_sales_price minus discount.
answer:
Step 1: left merge transactions with products on 'product_id' → shoppingdata = transactions.merge(products, how='left', on='product_id')
Step 2: left merge with promotions on ['product_id', 'week'] → shoppingdata = shoppingdata.merge(promotions, how='left', on=['product_id', 'week'])
Missing discount values filled with 0.
price = std_sales_price * (1 - discount/100)
